title: Numbers to 1000 Song #shorts | Little Takhti
description:
Sing along with Takhti and learn numbers to 1000! Ten ones make a ten, ten tens make a hundred, and every digit has its place: hundreds, tens and ones. Find out what the zero in 708 means, compare 452 and 425, count by hundreds to 1000, then shout the answers in the quiz.

Free printable worksheets, quizzes and games for this topic: https://littletakhti.com/class-2-maths-numbers-to-1000-worksheets/
